issue.title: [feat] Allow indexeddb databases to be stored in the AppImage bundle

repository.name: tauri
repository.description: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile applications with a web frontend.

issue.body:
### Describe the problem

The indexeddb databases are stored globally on the system (`~/.local/share/<bundle-identifier>/databases/indexeddb/**/*`), rather than in the AppImage bundle itself.


### Describe the solution you'd like

I don't know if this is possible, but it would be nice to have the option to store the indexeddb databases in the AppImage bundle itself, rather than in the `~/.local/share/<bundle-identifier>/databases/indexeddb/**/*` path.

### Alternatives considered

One workaround might be to just open a different database name, maybe as a UUID or something to minimize the possibility of a name clash, but ideally it would all be self-contained rather than global to guarantee that there isn't a namespace clash.

### Additional context

The use cases would be similar to those of sqlite. In my case, I want to be able to write an application (ie: `com.foo`), where the database is in the bundle itself, because the application is supposed to be standalone and used in multiple different contexts on the same machine. 
I'm not sure if this feature request is related to #6992.

body:
Thanks for the report!

i did a quick test (actually wasn't "quick". i'm not used to these old-school linux installers anymore 😅) and the issue seems to be that /usr/lib64 on void is just a symlink to /usr/lib. The appimage bundler only picks up the "real" file while webkitgtk is still looking for it at the symlink location ;/

p.s. these weird looking paths are correct, its working dir is `<appimage>/usr`

Edit: I'll assign myself for this issue for now but since i'll be busy over the weekend anyway it's okay (and encouraged) if someone else wants to take a look at it :) It's _hopefully_ as simple as telling the `cp` command to not follow symlinks...

issue.title: [bug] AppImage missing libwebkit2gtkinjectedbundle.so

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: This issue needs to triage, applied to new issues

repository.name: tauri
repository.description: Build smaller, faster, and more secure desktop and mobile applications with a web frontend.

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

Hi,

On Ubuntu 22.04.5

I bundled the a pristine project in AppImage and when running it, i get the following warning.

```sh
** (WebKitWebProcess:1195719): WARNING **: 10:14:55.371: Error loading the injected bundle (././/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/webkit2gtk-4.1/injected-bundle/libwebkit2gtkinjectedbundle.so): ././/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/webkit2gtk-4.1/injected-bundle/libwebkit2gtkinjectedbundle.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```

On ubuntu /lib is a symlink to /usr/lib, and I believed cargo linked on /lib and that the appimage bundler only put things into /usr inside the appimage according to the doc https://v2.tauri.app/distribute/appimage/. I checked the AppImage /tmp mount and libwebkit2gtkinjectedbundle isnt there even in the /usr path.

I tried adding the .so manually, but I didnt manage to do it quickly and thus thought it would be worth writing an issue so that it is either fixed, or better documented about how to add .so to solve such problems.

### Reproduction

Ubuntu 22.04.5

```sh
# Install deps
sudo apt update
sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
  build-essential \
  curl \
  wget \
  file \
  libxdo-dev \
  libssl-dev \
  libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
  librsvg2-dev

# Latest Rust stable 1.84.0 from rustup
# Nodejs 20 LTS from nodesource repositories

# Create new pristine project
cargo create-tauri-app
✔  Project name · tauri-app
✔ Identifier · com.tauri-app.app
✔ Choose which language to use for your frontend · TypeScript / JavaScript - (pnpm, yarn, npm, deno, bun)
✔ Choose your package manager · pnpm
✔ Choose your UI template · React - (https://react.dev/)
✔ Choose your UI flavor · TypeScript

# Run the AppImage
./src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/tauri-app_0.1.0_amd64.AppImage

# And see
** (WebKitWebProcess:1195719): WARNING **: 10:14:55.371: Error loading the injected bundle (././/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/webkit2gtk-4.1/injected-bundle/libwebkit2gtkinjectedbundle.so): ././/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/webkit2gtk-4.1/injected-bundle/libwebkit2gtkinjectedbundle.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```

Also I think there is sort of a caching thing because the first time at project creation I could choose vite or next and so on while now it selected vite without asking me what i wanted.

I've seen another issue and PR regarding a similar issue:
- https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/6992
- https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/6996/files

Maybe that can be of any help.


### Expected behavior

No Warning about missing .so, bundle the .so properly.
